name: Free Retirement Planner
text:
Retirement ke liye kitna paisa chahiye? 🤔

Apni age, kharcha aur savings daalo, aur 5 minute mein dekho ki aapka retirement number kitna hai aur har mahine kitna bachana hoga.

name: Free SIP Calculator
text:
Har mahine thoda-thoda SIP, lamba samay = bada fund. 📈

Dekho aapki monthly SIP 10, 15 ya 20 saal mein kitni ban sakti hai.

name: Free Lumpsum Calculator
text:
Bonus ya ek saath paisa aaya hai? 💰

Dekho ek baar ka investment alag-alag saalon aur return rate pe kitna ban sakta hai.

name: Free SWP Calculator
text:
Retirement ke baad har mahine pension jaisi income chahiye? 🏦

SWP calculator se dekho aapka fund kitne saal tak monthly income de sakta hai.

name: Free EPF Calculator
text:
Aapka PF retirement tak kitna banega? 🧾

Apni salary aur contribution daalo aur EPF ka andaaza lagao.

name: Free PPF Calculator
text:
PPF: tax bachat + safe saving. 🛡️

Dekho 15 saal mein har saal ka deposit kitna ban sakta hai.

name: Free NPS Calculator
text:
NPS se retirement pe kitna corpus aur kitni pension? 👴

Apne numbers daal ke khud check karo.

name: Free Income Tax Calculator
text:
Old regime ya new regime, aapke liye kaun sa better hai? 🧮

Apni salary aur deductions daalo aur dono ka tax compare karo.

name: Free HRA Calculator
text:
Kiraye pe rehte ho? 🏠

Dekho HRA mein kitna tax bach sakta hai.

name: Free Gratuity Calculator
text:
Job chhodte ya retire hote waqt gratuity kitni milegi? 🎁

Apni last salary aur saal daal ke turant dekho.

name: Free FD Calculator
text:
FD pe maturity amount kitna milega? 🏦

Rate aur time daalo aur interest ka hisaab dekho.

name: Free RD Calculator
text:
Har mahine chhoti saving, emergency fund ke liye perfect. 💡

RD calculator se maturity amount dekho.

name: Free Sukanya Samriddhi Calculator
text:
Beti ki padhai aur shaadi ke liye planning. 👧

Dekho Sukanya Samriddhi mein deposit kitna ban sakta hai.

name: Free Loan EMI Calculator
text:
Loan lene se pehle EMI aur total interest zaroor dekho. 📊

Amount, rate aur tenure daal ke turant hisaab lagao.

name: Free Home Loan Eligibility Calculator
text:
Ghar lene ka plan hai? 🏡

Dekho aapki salary pe kitna home loan mil sakta hai.

name: Free Term Insurance Calculator
text:
Family ke liye kitna life cover chahiye? ❤️

Apni income, loan aur zaroorat ke hisaab se cover ka andaaza lagao.

name: Free Inflation Calculator
text:
Aaj ka ₹1 lakh 20 saal baad kitna lagega? 📉

Inflation calculator se future kharcha dekho.

name: Free Expense Calculator
text:
Paisa kahan ja raha hai? 🧐

Apna monthly kharcha likho aur saving ka asli plan banao.

name: Free Life Goal Planner
text:
Ghar, gaadi, bachchon ki padhai, retirement. 🎯

Saare goals ek jagah plan karo aur dekho har mahine kitna bachana hai.

name: Free Asset Allocation Planner
text:
Equity, debt, gold: kitna-kitna rakhein? ⚖️

Apni age aur risk ke hisaab se simple allocation dekho.

name: Free Risk Profile Test
text:
Aap kitna risk le sakte ho? 🧭

2 minute ka test do aur apna investor profile jaano.

name: Free Net Worth Tracker
text:
Aapki asli net worth kitni hai? 📋

Assets aur loans likho aur apni financial health dekho.

name: Free CAGR Calculator
text:
Investment ne saal-dar-saal kitna return diya? 📈

CAGR calculator se sahi growth rate nikaalo.

name: Aaj ki Interest Rates
text:
FD, PPF, small savings: aaj ki rates kya hain? 📰

Ek jagah latest rates dekho.
